standard_prerequisites.name: Tate resolution construction
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the inductive skeleton this proof reuses ('exactly as in the statement and proof of Lemma lemma-tate-resolution').

standard_prerequisites.name: Koszul transition selection
standard_prerequisites.use: Chooses the tower n = n_0 < n_1 < ... < n_r = N with zero maps on positive homology, the spine of the construction.

core_obligations: Fix n; choose the tower n_0 < ... < n_r by the Koszul transition lemma and set N = n_r.
Construct A exactly as in the tate-resolution proof: A = colim A(m) with A(0) -> ... -> R/(f^N).

Build the maps: phi_1: A(1) -> K_{n_r} is an isomorphism (T_i maps to the Koszul generator xi_i); for m >= 2 the chosen vanishing on homology makes phi_1(e_i) a coboundary in K_{n_{r-1}}, and the universal property of divided power polynomial algebras produces phi_m compatible with d and gamma.
Extend past A(r+1) by sending new polynomial generators to zero, both towards A and towards K_n.
proof_roadmap: Select the tower, rebuild the resolution, and thread the compatible map family through the tower with the universal-property argument.
difficulty_reason: Template-reuse plus an inductive map-lifting argument; the coboundary mechanism and the universal-property applications must be exact.
